links.outcome: Functional status and mortality at discharge, AI-enabled vs non-AI spokes
links.effect: Workflow times and EVT utilisation improved with AI-enabled triage (e.g., DIDO adjusted difference -41.6 min), but clinical outcomes at discharge were similar between groups (all Q>0.05).
links.quote: Clinical outcomes, including functional status and mortality at discharge, were similar between groups (all Q>0.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world clinical and operational deployment of an AI-driven stroke imaging triage platform across multiple hospital hubs and spokes, comparing outcomes before vs after and with vs without the AI tool itself, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
